title: जीवन आचार्यका कविताहरूमा बन्धन र मोक्षको पुनव्र्याख्या {Redefining the Concept of "Bondage and Salvation" in Poems of Jeevan Acharya}
nepali: प्रस्तुत लेखमा साहित्यकार जीवन आचार्यका सिर्जनाको सङ्कलन तथा सम्पादन गरिएको कृति ‘सम्पूर्णमा जीवन आचार्य’ र ‘जीवन आचार्यका कविता’ पुस्तकमा समाविष्ट कविताहरूको अध्ययन गरिएको छ । जीवन आचार्यका विभिन्न कविताका अंशलाई दृष्टान्तका रूपमा उद्धृत गरी त्यसमा भएका तथ्यका आधारमा पूर्वीय वैदिक र अवैदिक दर्शनमा रहेका बन्धनका कारण र त्यसबाट पाइने मोक्षका उपायलाई नेपालको वर्तमान परिवेशलाई तुलना गर्दै पुनव्र्याख्या गरिएको छ । यस अध्ययनपत्रमा कवि आचार्यका कवितामा वैदिक र अवैदिक दुवै प्रकारका दर्शन, जीवनका चिन्तन र मोक्षका बाटालाई गहन रूपमा प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ । वर्तमान समयमा मानिसले भोग्नुपरेको सामाजिक, राजनीतिक, सांस्कृतिक, धार्मिक आदि बन्धनका तथ्यपूर्ण कुरालाई कवितामा प्रस्तुत विम्बका आधारमा पुनव्र्याख्या गरी मोक्षको बाटो पनि केलाइएको छ । वैदिक र अवैदिक दर्शनले भनेको बन्धन र मोक्षलाई मात्र नहेरी वर्तमान अवस्थाको बन्धन के हो र त्यसबाट मोक्ष प्राप्तिको बाटो के हो भन्ने कुरालाई पनि बुझ्नुपर्ने हुन्छ । यो अध्ययनपत्र तिनै आधारलाई केन्द्रमा राखी तयार पारिएको हो ।
american_english: In this article, poems included in the works "Sampurnama Jeevan Acharya" and "Jeevan Acharyaka Kavita", which are collections and compilations of the creations of the writer Jeevan Acharya, are studied. By citing excerpts from various poems of Jeevan Acharya as illustrations and on the basis of the facts contained in them, the causes of bondage and the means of attaining liberation from it found in Eastern Vedic and non-Vedic philosophies are reinterpreted in comparison with Nepal's present context. In this study paper, both Vedic and non-Vedic philosophies, reflections on life, and the path to liberation are presented in depth in the poems of poet Acharya. On the basis of the images presented in the poems, the factual matters of the social, political, cultural, religious, and other forms of bondage that people have to endure in the present time are reinterpreted, and the path to liberation is also pointed out. Rather than looking only at the bondage and liberation described by Vedic and non-Vedic philosophies, it is also necessary to understand what bondage is in the present condition and what the path to attaining liberation from it is. This study paper has been prepared by keeping these very bases at its center.

informal_english: In this article, it looks at poems included in "Sampurnama Jeevan Acharya" and "Jeevan Acharyaka Kavita", which are collections and compilations of writer Jeevan Acharya's work. By pulling out excerpts from different poems by Jeevan Acharya as examples and going by the facts in them, it reinterprets the causes of bondage and the ways to get liberation from it found in Eastern Vedic and non-Vedic philosophies, comparing them with Nepal's current situation. In this study paper, both Vedic and non-Vedic philosophies, reflections on life, and the path to liberation are laid out in depth in poet Acharya's poems. Based on the images in the poems, it reinterprets the real stuff about the social, political, cultural, religious, and other kinds of bondage that people have to deal with these days, and it also points out the path to liberation. Instead of just looking at the bondage and liberation talked about by Vedic and non-Vedic philosophies, we also need to understand what bondage looks like right now and what the path to getting free from it actually is. This study paper's been put together with those very points front and centre.
